$comment: ADR-0073 §6 V12, rules L3/L4: reviewed acknowledgements of sentences in APPROVED gate records DG0–DG6, which are never rewritten (D-243 Q13). Each entry names the rule, the record, the JSON path and the SHA-256 of the exact sentence (as tools/release/lib/gate-labels.mjs splits it), so any change to the sentence makes it a hit again. Only L3/L4 and only gates/DG0–DG6.json can be acknowledged; DG7's own record, the envelope README and the final report never can. An entry that matches nothing in a checked record is stale and fails V12. verify-seal reads this file from the sealed payload archive, so the list that counts is the one reviewed with the candidate. Added by T-DG7-DO-J2 for DO-J O1 (D-266 (b)); an acknowledgement approves nothing and grants no business, Finance or IT approval.
